answer.rationale: Write-path p99 has ramped over 90 minutes during daily settlement peak, which matches saturation more than an immediate bad-build error spike; add_capacity historically kept queues flat under surge without dropping writes. A same-day release remains a plausible cause, so rollback is the main alternative and is being source-checked, but it is not chosen first because the symptom is climbing latency under heavy writes rather than a confirmed checkout error regression. Circuit breaking is avoided because failing fast could lose customer writes. Uncertainty between release and load is preserved; only a guarded capacity add is intended until archives return.
